prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for a clean comic medieval fantasy mobile tower-defense game. Match the supplied approved style reference: dark espresso confident outlines, chunky purposeful silhouettes, 2 or 3 hard-edged painted values, restrained broad highlights. Readable, manually designed feeling. No photorealism, airbrush, plastic gloss, gratuitous tiny engravings or microscopic texture, soft glow, external cast shadow, text, letters, numbers, watermark or UI screenshot. One SINGLE isolated miniature battlefield DIORAMA on a floating oval chunk of ochre earth and chunky sandstone, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera about 35 degrees looking downward, the SAME view used for medieval mobile game level islands. Whole island and ALL props comfortably inside square image with 12% transparent margin. The island top is a warm winding dirt road crossing between a few grouped props, the foreground cross section is shallow chunky warm rock, with a few broad angular grass clumps. No pedestal, no frame, no object outside the island, no haze, no particles. Favor strong large masses and clean color separation. Road is broad, unoccupied and easy to read. MONSTER LAIR theme: squat dark rocky cave at back-center with an ivory horn-shaped bone lintel and a dark entrance, two small ragged warm-red cloth pennants either side, chunky brown-gray cave rocks, sparse warm green edge shrubs, a small stack of TWO stylized ivory bones at front-right. A broad golden dirt trail leads from cave to front-center. Playful fantasy menace, not horror. Simple clear asymmetrical large shapes and warm/cool color contrast. No characters, skull face-shaped terrain, monster or glowing cave.
